title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2022 · Fmge Mini Test 39

questions.stem: An intellectually challenged teenager was diagnosed with a trinucleotide repeat mutation disease. On examination, his IQ is 49. He has a long face with a large mandible, everted large ears, a high-arched palate, and large testicles. What is the most likely nucleotide repeat sequence in this condition?
